title.value: SOTIF Entropy: Online SOTIF Risk Quantification and Mitigation for Autonomous Driving
title.justification: The paper's focus is on quantifying and mitigating the Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) risks in autonomous driving, as indicated in the title.
title.quote: SOTIF Entropy: Online SOTIF Risk Quantification and Mitigation for Autonomous Driving

extractions.description: The paper presents a Self-Surveillance and Self-Adaption System that aims to minimize Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) risks in autonomous driving. It involves monitoring, quantifying, and mitigating both inherent and external risks by using the entropy of perception algorithms like YOLOv5. Various experiments, including Hardware-in-the-Loop experiments, are conducted to verify the efficiency and effectiveness of the system in real-time traffic environments.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the technical advancement of autonomous vehicle safety rather than directly addressing climate change or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Autonomous driving confronts great challenges in complex traffic scenarios, where the risk of Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) can be triggered by the dynamic operational environment and system insufficiencies.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on any aspect of climate or ecological-related sustainable development categories. It is centered around autonomous driving safety performance.
primary_category.quote: How to minimize the SOTIF risk for autonomous driving is currently a critical, difficult, and unresolved issue.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no relevant sub-category aligning with the content of this paper as per the predefined sustainable development categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: A Self-Surveillance and Self-Adaption System was proposed to monitor, quantify, and mitigate the SOTIF risk.

applications.value: Online SOTIF Risk Quantification and Mitigation for Autonomous Driving
applications.justification: The paper elaborates on a system to systematically quantify and mitigate SOTIF risks in autonomous vehicles using artificial intelligence and entropy calculation.
applications.quote: Therefore, this paper proposes the 'Self-Surveillance and Self-Adaption System' as a systematic approach to online minimize the SOTIF risk, which aims to provide a systematic solution for monitoring, quantification, and mitigation of inherent and external risks.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper does not align with any existing or new sustainable development categories, as it primarily deals with improving technical risk quantification in autonomous driving systems.
new_primary_category.quote: However, the introduced systematic solutions were incapable of addressing SOTIF issues associated with trigger conditions... Future systematic solutions for AVs must therefore consider monitoring the limitations of algorithms and making self-adaptive safe decisions.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category related to sustainable development can be derived since the focus remains on technical aspects of autonomous driving safety.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This study investigates a demonstration of the proposed Self-Surveillance and Self-Adaption System for processing perception algorithm risk.
